parts.title: The Tryouts
parts.text: Nobody expected Sahil to sign up for the basketball tryouts. The **wicked** heat of summer training was brutal — 5 AM every morning, rain or shine, and even the grass on the practice field began to **wilt**. But Sahil's first **task** was simply to make the team, and she attacked it with a ferocious will that surprised everyone watching.

parts.title: The Doubters
parts.text: Her teammates didn't welcome her at first. People said it wasn't **typical** for someone her age to compete at this level, and the remarks began to **vex** her, but she would not listen to the voices that told her to quit. Saanvi, the coach, used all the **resources** she had to support Sahil — extra drills, film sessions where they would **peer** closely at every move, and encouragement. When a careless **blunder** in practice left her with a sprained ankle, Sahil rested one week and came back stronger.

parts.title: The Turning Point
parts.text: During the semifinal, a rival player let out a **squeal** of shock when Sahil faked past her with speed nobody expected. Sahil could feel the **spine** of the crowd's energy running through her. The **quality** of her performance in those **final** minutes was unlike anything she had shown before. The ball left her hands and sailed through the net, and the gymnasium erupted.

parts.title: Victory
parts.text: They won the championship by a single point in the final seconds. Sahil was lifted onto her teammates' shoulders. The old wooden bleachers showed some wear around the edges, but nobody noticed — every eye was on Sahil. Saanvi told the reporters, "She's the hardest-working athlete I've ever coached. Everyone doubted her, but she proved them all wrong." That night, Sahil looked at her medal and smiled. The underdog had become the champion.

secretPassage.passage: Arjun had one _(1)_ job — a single piece of work assigned to him — before the school science fair ended. He had to _(2)_ closely through his magnifying glass at a sample of fallen bark to see exactly how it had begun to rot and break down. A bunch of flowers beside the sample had begun to _(3)_ in the hot sun, their petals drooping and brown. This was no _(4)_ project — it was unlike anything his classmates had attempted before. His partner made a clumsy _(5)_ — a careless mistake — and knocked a jar of soil off the table. He had limited _(6)_ — only a few tools and materials — so he had to plan carefully. The bark sample had a tough _(7)_ running through its center, a stiff column that held it together even as it rotted. A _(8)_ little beetle — mean and sharp-jawed — scurried out of the bark and onto Arjun's hand. The _(9)_ of his work was excellent, so careful and thorough that his teacher stopped to admire it. A smaller boy let out a sudden _(10)_ of excitement when he saw Arjun's display. Loud chatter from the next table began to _(11)_ him, but he stayed focused no matter how tired he felt. The _(12)_ step was to present his findings to the judges, and he did so with perfect confidence.
